messages:
maria: Quick notice — planning a mini cutover tonight 23:00 UTC to flip shared-config v2 -> v3. Affects API, runtime, console, router prefixes. Need a short handshake and eviction plan. @sam @kevin can you ack?

sam: Ack, can do. What's the rollback trigger?

kevin: I can be on standby for router changes. Rollback if 95th latency > 250ms for 5m or error rate +2% on runtime.

maria: Sounds good. We'll run a small mirror-canary (5% traffic) for 10m then promote. deploy-bot will execute canary job.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled job created: `mini-cutover/shared-config/v3` -> canary 5% at 23:00 UTC. Steps: 1) snapshot configs 2) roll v3 to api-runtime pair 3) router header swap 4) promote. Link: https://deploys.internal/runs/mini-cutover-1765559999 :eyes:

tasha: For console: we need a short migration flag for old dashboards, I'll add it to release notes. Ensure console pins fall back to v2 when header missing.

sam: Suggest adding a temporary route-level pin for 30m after promote in case we need quick revert. Can deploy-bot support pinning?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: yes — adding `pin` step after promote with 30m TTL. Command preview:
```
deploy-bot pin --service router --variant v2 --ttl 30m --owner @sam
```

kevin: Confirming KV eviction order: runtime should drain KV prefixes before router header flip. Otherwise we risk stale cache hits. Who will run the drain?

maria: I'll coordinate runtime drain. Plan: 1) stop writes for the prefix 2) wait 30s for in-flight 3) flush KV cache 4) flip headers.

tasha: Adding release note bullet: "Shared-config v3: smaller keys, improved routing. Rollback: pin to v2; console will show migration banner."

sam: If canary looks clean at 10m, we promote and monitor for 30m before unpinning. Revert plan: run `deploy-bot revert --run-id 1765559999` and re-pin router to v2.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: smoke checks to run during canary: healthcheck (200), latency p50/p95, error-rate. Posting automated report to #release-metrics.

kevin: I'll watch router logs and be ready to cut traffic back. If anything odd, call the rollback and I'll run the revert commands.

maria: Thanks — looks like we have owners. Final checklist before 23:00: snapshot (maria), canary kick (deploy-bot), runtime drain (maria), router standby (kevin), console flag (tasha). Ping here when done. :thumbsup:
